company.description: RoboTire automates vehicle maintenance using software, computer vision, and robotics, starting with 10-minute tire replacements. The company was founded in 2018 by Victor Darolfi and is headquartered in San Carlos, California, United States.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven robotic system that automates the complete tire-changing process including removal, installation, and torqueing according to OEM specifications.

aiResearchSummary.text: RoboTire is engaged in developing systems for automated vehicle wheel removal and replacement, as described in 'Automated removal and replacement of vehicle wheels and tires,' which integrates robotic apparatus and computer-controlled lifts. Research also includes computer vision-based methods for identifying vehicle lifting points, as detailed in 'Low rise vehicle lift and method of operation,' and machine learning techniques for accurately locating lug nut centers, as in 'Locating a center point of a lug nut for an automated vehicle wheel removal.'

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $10,650,000, or 98.61% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,311,838 to $48,524,374, a 11.25x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 64 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
